# Architecture Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that the architecture is bounded, separated, contract-defined, and free of undocumented drift
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Legend**: `[M]` mandatory (a constitution MUST, an approved requirement, or an approved decision); `[O]` optional enhancement or backlog boundary. `G0` is evaluable now against the approved specification, plan, ADRs, and contracts; `G1` is evaluable after `/speckit-tasks` and `/speckit-analyze`, before implementation. `{Detects: ...}` links an item to a failure pattern in the [README](README.md) detection matrix. Dimension tags: Completeness, Clarity, Consistency, Measurability, Coverage, Traceability, Edge Case, Assumption, Conflict, Gap.
## Boundaries and Ownership

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the system boundary, actors, external dependencies, trust boundaries TB-1..7, runtime components, data ownership, and plane responsibilities all defined? [Completeness, Plan §1, Security §2] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK002 - Does any document allow the control plane to read the application database, or the reverse (negative path)? [Consistency, Plan §1.5, ADR-016] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is each requirement class assigned an enforcement owner (domain, adapter, or policy) so none is unowned? [Completeness, Traceability §4] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the plane-to-plane interaction defined, including how shortener behavior reaches scenario evidence? [Clarity, Plan §1.5] [M, G0]

## Separation and Interfaces

- [ ] CHK005 - Are domain, delivery, persistence, orchestration, policy, telemetry, and infrastructure concerns separated by an enforceable rule with a defined build failure? [Measurability, Constitution VII, POL-ARCH-001, ADR-016] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are external dependencies reached through named ports (AgentPort, Clock, Telemetry, repositories) with defined replacement and failure behavior? [Coverage, Constitution VII, ADR-005, ADR-010] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is every API operation defined in an authored contract with request, response, error schemas, status codes, and reason codes? [Completeness, Contracts] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are versioning and compatibility rules defined, with a failure when declared and computed impact differ? [Measurability, Contracts README §2, Spec NFR-010] [M, G0]

## State, Data, and Dependencies

- [ ] CHK009 - Are persistence schemas defined for every Key Entity, including constraints for unique codes, atomic state, and append-only audit? [Completeness, Data Model, Spec FR-006, FR-018, FR-130] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the idempotency check-and-commit defined as one single-store transaction, with Redis limited so correctness never depends on it? [Clarity, Spec DEC-034, DEC-067, ADR-015, ADR-026] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is behavior defined when Redis is unavailable, and when PostgreSQL is unavailable? [Coverage, ADR-015, Spec FR-019, FR-021] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is each architecture-critical number traced to an approved source (PVT, PA, DEC), with none introduced unapproved? [Traceability, Spec DEC-063, DEC-113, ADR-023] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the environment prerequisite (Docker, containers) stated with a defined stop outcome if unmet? [Completeness, Spec DEC-069, Plan CP-1] [M, G0]

## Change and Drift

- [ ] CHK014 - Is a Constitution Check recorded per principle I..XI, with re-check triggers on architecture change? [Completeness, Governance, Plan §4] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is architecture drift defined as code or contracts diverging from the documented layout and accepted ADRs, with a detecting check? [Measurability, ADR-009 CV-05, POL-ARCH-002] [M, G0] {Detects: undocumented-architecture-drift}
- [ ] CHK016 - Must a change to architecture, schema, security control, or workflow state pass impact analysis and approval before taking effect? [Coverage, Spec FR-126, POL-CHG-005] [M, G0] {Detects: change-without-formal-approval}
- [ ] CHK017 - Are stack, runtime, image, and "no CI" constraints stated consistently across plan, research, ADRs, and quickstart? [Consistency, Spec DEC-060, DEC-071, DEC-098, DEC-099] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is production-scale infrastructure explicitly out of scope, with the prototype's limits stated? [Coverage, Spec EXC-006, Plan summary] [O, G0]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items marked `[Gap]` or `[Conflict]` name a place where the current documents are silent or disagree; they are findings for the reviewer to resolve, not pre-judged results
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially within this file (`CHK001` onward); cite them as `<file>:CHKnnn`
